fg.title: Asseɣ deg Saygun, s tazehṛa
fg.lede: Amek ara tettreqbeḍ deg temdint, d min ara telseḍ zdat n ugḍud-ines, akked wanect n wayen i tzemreḍ a t-tesɣeḍ s tidet ger yiwen alamma tlatin n wussan — amdakel amaslay n tebdart-nneɣ n llebsa.
fg.updated: Tira n ubrid · ttwaleqqment ass n Yulyuz 2026 · Saygun (HCMC)
fg.h1: Amussu deg temdint: amagrad n xe ôm (taksi n muṭu)
fg.moving.2: Saygun tettidir ɣef sin yiferdisen — ɣas d 8.5 imelyan n imuṭuten i tesɛa imelyan n imezdaɣ — akken daɣen i telha teɣzin n useɣ dagi. Tetteddaweḍ s iḍaren deg wammas n ugraw yiwen, tettrekbeḍ s umuṭu ger sin igrawen; ɛecṛa n twenatin s umuṭu ttɛawadent Taɣiwant 1 ɣer Taɣiwant 3. Tarusi tella deg iferdisen ur nbennu: anwa asnas, anwa asrag, akked min ara texdmeḍ s krad icekkaren n tḥanut d unẓar i d-iteddun.
fg.moving.4: Krad i yesɛan azal: Grab, Be, akked Xanh SM, agraw n imuṭuten VinFast n Vingroup, akk s tẓergent. I unebdad, asteqsi ur illi deg wazal maca deg wacu asnas ittɛawan s tidet s tkarḍa tabeṛṛanit d uḍris abeṛṛani — dinna, yiwen usiwel iṭṭef amkan amezwaru.
fg.moving.5: Isnasen n ukraz ttwamqabalen i inebdaden
fg.moving.12: Asnas amagnu n temnaḍt — d yiwen n usnas i ixedmen s tidet i inebdaden seg tazwara ar tagara: uṭṭunen ibeṛṛaniyen, tikarḍiwin Visa/Mastercard tibeṛṛaniyin deg usnas, s Tenglizit s tummant.
fg.moving.15: Sebded-t send ad tazleḍ. Tiwrisin, beṭṭu n ubrid, ammesteb n uxeṣṣam.
fg.moving.17: Imuṭuten d tkeṛṛuṭṭiwin s tẓergent VinFast s inehharen s uweqqar, ttwabedren s waṭas d agraw ifazen. Tallalt n tikarḍiwin tibeṛṛaniyin mazal ur tesbeggen ara akk — awi-d idrimen s ufus fell-as.
fg.moving.18: Azal ibedden — ulac asali deg ussan n ukersi
fg.moving.19: Mi ittali wazal n Grab (anẓar, asrag n ukersi), azal ibedden n Xanh yettrebbeḥ s tsusmi.
fg.moving.21: Afran n imezdaɣ, s wamek amagnu 5–10% ddaw n Grab — maca yesra s tidet uṭṭun n tefunast n Fitnam, idrimen s ufus d ubrid amagnu.
fg.moving.23: Yuklal a t-textareḍ mi tesɛiḍ tikarḍa taɣellanit; mačči send.
fg.moving.24: Azal d imḍanen, seg ugur n 2026. * Amḍan D1 ↔ Thảo Điền d asikel-nneɣ seg tɣatasin n uzal s ukilumitr yettwasekren — sefreq asnas send ad tazleḍ. Uslig ilhan: Grab d amezwaru, Xanh SM d amagnu n idrimen s ufus.
fg.moving.25: Seg unafag n Tân Sơn Nhất: GrabBike tettazzal ~90–140k₫ ma d GrabCar ~120–280k₫ ɣer Taɣiwant 1, ittbeddal s usrag, tisurfat n yiḍ ẓẓayit zemrent ad ssemɣwrent azal s snat. Deg tzeqqa tabeṛṛanit, amkan n ukemmes n Grab yettwaḥettem ɣer tallunt yettwaseknen — sebded uqbel, dɣa ddu s iḍaren, sefeḍ akk win i k-d-ittɛerraḍen deg ubrid.
fg.moving.26: Xe ôm n webrid, s tidet
fg.moving.27: Isnasen sḥebsen aṭas n usqerdec deg webrid, maca mačči akk. Azal ilhan deg webrid d 10–15k₫ i ukilumitr; asteqsi amezwaru i ibeṛṛaniyen ibeddu s snat n ugars n win n umezdaɣ. Myussanet ɣef uṭṭun send ad teqqimeḍ; aru-t deg tiliɣri-inek sekn-as-t. Snat n tḥilatin timagnutin d “ur tefhimeḍ ara, wagi d iddulaṛen” akked wazal yettwasɛeddan mi tewwḍeḍ; kṛad-nsent ttwazenzent mi yella wuṭṭun yettwaqebḍen s tira ger-awen. Abrid s tidet yeqbel di krad n twaliwin kan: tiliɣri-inek temmut, anẓar yessuli isnasen ɣer 2.5×, neɣ tiwnat d tin n twenat n usemmid kan.
fg.moving.29: Icekkaren imecṭaḥ ttrekkabent ger iḍaren-inek, ɣef uceṛṛi, neɣ deg tesga ddaw n ukersi. Sennig snat n icekkaren n tḥanut, ur ttḥettim ara iman-ik: sebded ɣer GrabCar — tiwenat timecṭaḥ deg wammas n temdint drusent kan 30–70k₫ — neɣ azen aseɣ-inek zdat-k. GrabExpress Same-Day tewwuḍ ɣer usiwan-inek deg 2–6 n twenatin seg ~20k₫ s tefla, Xanh SM yesɛa daɣen ayen yettemcaben. Acekkar n llebsa ur nettwazday ara yettrekkab dima deg tkeṛṛuṭṭa.
fg.moving.30: Tidet ur nesɛi ara tazehṛa ɣef tiliɣra: akerraz n tiliɣra seg ufus d amgirred ittwabedren s waṭas ɣer inebdaden dagi, akked imukan-is — Bến Thành, Nguyễn Huệ, Đồng Khởi, Bùi Viện — d nutni s timmad-nsen iberdan n useɣ. Ur qqim ara ɣef ubarid tsekkiḍ ɣer tkarḍa n Grab; uɣal ɣer deffir seg webrid akken ad tesbedeḍ, ls acekkar-inek s uneggaru ɣer tesga n texxamt (jakit n tfukt fell-as ad t-ikellex akkin), sḥudd tiliɣri-inek mi ara tettrekbeḍ.
fg.moving.31: Inehharen ṭṭfen kask n unebgi s ccariɛa — d ayen yettwaḥetmen mačči d luks, yelha i tiwenat timecṭaḥ. Ar ugur n 2026 ulac asnas i d-yefkan afran n unehhar tameṭṭut i nezmer a t-nsenqed; tiḥila timagnutin d beṭṭu n ubrid deg usnas, amsasa n tsarut d wudem uqbel ad ternuḍ, akked tẓergent s uweqqar n Xanh SM.
fg.moving.33: Seg Mayyu ar Wamber, ajenna yeɣli tagara n mkul ass — s tazwara, s tissas, s teɣzi tawezlant. Inehharen ṭṭfen s wamagnu poncho (aselsi n unẓar) n unebgi ihegga, ad t-k-fken s teḥsent; qbel-t. Azal yettali ɣer 2.5× deg tguni; ihi tiḥila tazehṛant d tin n umezdaɣ: kcem ɣer tqehwa dɣa eǧǧ 30–60 n twenatin ad ɛeddint. Yezmer daɣen ad yili udrus n idrimen wala ma trekbeḍ deg unẓar, yerna ad teqqimeḍ tayussi.
fg.moving.34: Melmi ad terkbeḍ, melmi ad teffreḍ
fg.moving.35: Asrag n ukersi yettazzal ger 7 ar 9 s tefrara akked 5 ar 7 tameddit, s wazal yettalin. Maca abeṛṛid mačči d aɛdaw-inek s tidet — d aḥmu i t-illan. Amḍan n tfukt (UV) yettaggara ger 11:00 d 13:00 ass ideg iseggasen, tḥanutin qqiment ldint ar 21:30, ihi ass ittebna iman-is: igrawen s iḍaren s tefrara, asemmiḍ deg wammas n wass, dɣa tazizawt tameqqrant seg 16:00 skidd — dagi ay tettidir tegmert n useɣ n Saygun.
fg.moving.37: Ammas n Đồng Khởi–Nguyễn Huệ–Lê Lợi n Taɣiwant 1 s tidet yettwaddu s iḍaren — Nguyễn Huệ d abrid s tidet i wid s iḍaren — ammas n D1/D3 daɣen yettwaddu s tuɣzit tamecṭuḥt. Beɛd wayen, iberdan n iḍaren llan i imuṭuten yebedden, icekkaren n imzenza, akked yiwen umuṭu i d-yettuɣalen ɣef ubrid; ttheggi ad tkecmeḍ ɣer webrid dɣa a d-tuɣaleḍ. Tiwenat n useɣ n Thảo Điền d igrawen mecṭaḥen i iḍaren ger tiwenat, mačči d tikli tazegzawt. Azri n webrid d cra n usmenyaf-is: ffeɣ s ṭṭawil, sɛiddi tissas yiwet, war abeddi, war azzel — asemmal n webrid ad k-yeẓr ad d-yettemsar-ak. Tafat n webrid d tin n usmuttag kan.
fg.moving.38: Metṛo, d melmi tzemreḍ ad tebɣiḍ tkeṛṛuṭṭa
fg.moving.39: Izirig 1 n Metṛo (yeldi seg Dujember 2024) d tiririt tasusamt i tiwenat D1 ↔ Thảo Điền: Bến Thành ɣer Thảo Điền neɣ An Phú deg 10–12 n twenatin, 7–20k₫ mkul tiwenat, tazrirt n wass s 40k₫, ikeṛṛiyen mkul 8–12 n twenatin alamma d 22:00. S usemmiḍ, war aɣellel n usqerdec, ittɛawan akk s icekkaren n useɣ — asuffeɣ ihi d tikli n cwiṭ n imitren s uḥmu seg imukan uɛlayen. Takeṛṛuṭṭa tettrebbeḥ ɣef umuṭu mkul melmi llan aṭas n icekkaren, acekkar n llebsa, anẓar, neɣ krad n tiwenat neɣ ugar deg yiwet n twenat. Snat n tẓergin n tuksi s uzal ibedden llant d Vinasun (amellal, s izirig azeggaɣ-azegzaw) akked Mai Linh (azegzaw) — ~12k₫ tazwara, dɣa ~15k₫ mkul ukilumitr — ttrebbḥent ɣef Grab deg yiḍ, mi ara yedrus usnas dɣa yettali wazal. Ḥader ɣer tikeṛṛuṭṭin i icebḥen i tinna maca s tsertit n ukersi n usmuttag.
fg.h2: Llebsa i temdint: tafukt, adɣaɣ n ugu, akked unẓar n taggara
fg.wardrobe.2: Ha-tt tɣawsa yettwassnen ɣef Saygun deg ustayl-ines: llebsa yesɛan azal ameqqran deg temdint d nitenti daɣen seg tid yettwassnen s wudem-nsent. Wid ara ternuḍ yid-sen deg mkul amrezg llsen seg iqerra ar iḍaren mgal tafukt — llebsa-nsen tekfa idrimen dagi, telha dagi, yerna ur telli ara s sshalt deg tmurt-ik. Amur-agi d amagrad d tebdart n useɣ akken kan.
fg.wardrobe.4: Ulac lawan n tfukt tadrust deg Saygun. Amḍan-ines yettili aɛlay alamma d asemgal ass ideg iseggasen — s tiggi n 13–15 seg Fuṛar ar Wambeṛ, ula Dujember–Yennayer teqqim tuggi ɣer 10, anda aglim ur netti ara yettbeddil llun deg cwiṭ n uskkil ur netaggara ara ɛecṛa n tedqiqin. Aɛlay n wass d 11:00–13:00. Daymi, i wass n useɣ, aɣummu yugar tazmilt: UPF d amtiweg n SPF deg llebsa, maca s wazal ittwaḥerzen ugar — yettwazen deg-s asḥebbes n UVA akked UVB imddukal, ma d SPF yettmagg asḥebbes n UVB kan, yerna llebsa ur tettazi ara, ur tettmḥa ara, ur nesra ara ad tettwaselk mkul snat n twenatin. UPF 50+ tenna-d belli ugar n 98% n UV ittwaḥbes — d azal i sqedcen tirniwin n ccada s tidet. Snat n tɣawsiwin i twaliḍ: aḥettu yettadar mi tebna llebsa neɣ tettuzzel, akked llebsa yeqqnen s ini ibeṛkanen ixdem ugar n mkul tanaḍt.
fg.wardrobe.6: Ayen ttlusun s tidet imezdaɣ yesɛa awal-ines. Áo chống nắng (jakit mgal tafukt) tettemcabi ɣer tjakit tameqqrant s uqemmuc yugar udem, s tuɣac i ḍudan, s ifassen iɣezfen ar ifassen, ittwaxdem i ukersi n umuṭu. Váy chống nắng (izerf mgal tafukt) d izerf yettwalsen sennig llebsa akken ad yeɣumm iḍaren mi tettrekbeḍ (seg ~299k₫; ula MUJI Fitnam tzenz yiwen s yisem “izerf n umuṭu”). Găng tay chống nắng (agant iɣezfen ar tɣenja) d agant mgal tafukt; khẩu trang chống nắng (kammama mgal tafukt) d ikammamen n leqmac i yeɣummen udem d taɣut; icekkiwen d yizerfan n iḍaren ttiliwent daɣen. Mi ttwaddamen akk — jakit, izerf, agant, kammama, tibinaḍ n tfukt, s waṭas s ineflan — asekkil yugar akk yesɛa isem n useglef, “Ninja Lead,” seg umuṭu ideg yeṭṭeṣ ugar. Ijakiten n mmarq zzalen ~200–800k₫; wid n webrid drusen ugar, s tɣatasin n UV s wazal yettwaḥeqqen amek i t-tettmenniḍ. Akk yettwazenza dinna dinna: tḥanutin n mmarq, Shopee d Lazada, akked yisebbanen n webrid.
fg.wardrobe.8: Isekkilen i d-iteddun ttwazenzen s ccada neɣ d ismawen ittwassnen i llebsa mgal tafukt deg temdint, ar ugur n 2026. Anda tansa tusa-d seg yiwen n uɣbalu, nekcem-as tanzagt — azen izen uqbel ad tazleḍ. Deg tebdart-nneɣ, isekkilen n uḥettu mgal tafukt qqimen ddaw llebsa n usport deg tebdart.

fg.wardrobe.50: Tazwart ɣef tira tamecṭuḥt, acku dagi ay nettwaxelleṣ akken ad nili s tidet: “chống nắng” ɣef tabelt d tagrumma, mačči d azgal. Yal ayen yezmer ad yettwazzenz s isem n “mgal tafukt”; azal UPF yettwabderen seg umahil s yisem d tayri nniḍen, ma d ccada n uɣlif am win n ARPANSA — abrid n UV100 — d azgal aqbuṛ. Aṭas n isekkilen n webrid ittwassnen (yiwen deg-sen yesbedd “UPF50+++,” d tazmilt ur nelli ara) zzenzen ɣef tazgalt kan. Zemrent ad ilint d ijakiten ifazen. Maca ma yella uzal-a yesɛa azal ɣur-k, aɣ anda azal ittwabder.
fg.wardrobe.52: Agu yugar diri seg Wamber ar Yennayer — abeddel n tegrest s wugu send ad d-tuɣal tguni. Yiwen wass n Yennayer 2026 yesres temdint ɣer umkan wis sebɛa gar temdinin timeqqranin s AQI n 166, ma d tazwilt n 2024 tewweḍ azal n rebɛa n tergalin n WHO ass ideg aseggas; deg wammas n useggas, deg tguni, tuɣac drusit s wamagnu. Ikammamen zrin akk taɣuct-ini dagi — d taɣawsa tamagnut mgal ugu d tafukt akken. I usḥebbes s tidet, tḥanutin n ssidwan Pharmacity d Long Châu sɛant 3M KF94 s ~29k₫, s waṭas s usifeḍ n wazal. Sɛeddi-t: ikammamen icebḥen n leqmac n khẩu trang chống UV n mmarq n tfukt ḥebbsen tafukt, mačči tiɣersiwin timecṭaḥ n ugu. Ifecka yemgarraden.
fg.wardrobe.53: Anẓar, d tarezzeft n áo mưa
fg.wardrobe.54: Aseggas n unẓar yettazzal seg Mayyu ar Wamber: tafrara s wudem amagnu tugi, dɣa asegres seg 2 ar 5 tameddit ittɛeddi seg yiwet ar krad n twenatin, aɛlay-is seg Ɣuct ar Tuber. Tiririt tamagnut d áo mưa — poncho n umuṭu, yettwakres akken ad yeɣumm anebdad d ifassen n umuṭu, s waṭas s tesga tazrart i wanda tafat n umuṭu tettεeddi; llan daɣen wid i sin yemdanen. Tarezzeft: iponchoen n uzemz n yiwet n tikkelt seg yal taḥanut s cwiṭ n wazal; Rando, amaslay Fitnami seg 1987, seg ~61k₫ alamma d 180–307k₫ i tegrumma-ines n uzal aɛlayan war phthalate; Givi s llebsa n unẓar seg ~400k₫ ma yella ad terkbeḍ mkul ass. Ssuq yeččuṛ s “Givi Rando” n lekdeb s 100–200k₫ — aɣ seg taḥanut s tidet. Ayen yellan deg tacekkart-nneɣ seg Mayyu skidd: yiwen uponcho yettwakresen, akked tansa n teqhwa iqerben ifazen.

fg.itineraries.2: Amek i ttwabnan isɣnuten-a. Nemyagar temdint akken tessra tegtemsit-ines: d tesɛa n tɣiwanin s tuzzuft ur nemsaḍa, mkul yiwet ttwaddaw s iḍaren send ad tettwasqedec yiwet n tiwenat. Mkul ass yesɛa yiwen neɣ sin igrawen, weradeg krad; imukan imezwura ttwabedden zik dɣa tḥanutin timecṭaḥ ternunt ɣer tikli i ten-yezrin. Tifrarin llant i ugraw i ilhan i uldi zik, ussan ger 11:30 d 15:00 i usemmiḍ d imekli, dɣa tazizawt tameqqrant n 17:00–21:30 — tḥanutin n Saygun qqiment ldint aṭas — i webrid s uɣlaq aneggaru. Taḥanut tetteṭṭef ɛecrin ar xemsa u ttlatin n tesdatin mi ara ttwaliḍ s tidet; tmanya ar ɛecra n tḥanutin d ass yeččuṛen, ayen kan i d-yenna wul-ik ɣef imekli. Tiwenat tiɣezfin ternunt tamnaḍt wala ussan yeččuṛen ugar, mkul asɣenu yesɛa amkan yettwabderen i uḥbas zik — acku anẓar, aḥmu d twaɣit d ayen n temdint, mačči d ayen n usɣenu i yexṣaren.
fg.itineraries.3: 1 wassTabɣest — ammas n Taɣiwant 1, dɣa izirig n usnulfu n D3＋
fg.itineraries.4: Nɣel abrid
fg.itineraries.5: I wi ilaq: assemmus n unafag, yiwen wass ilelli, taɛemmirt tamezwarut. Ayen i t-yeɣummen s tidet: ɛecra ar tnac seg ~110 n tḥanutin n ukcum n temdint — azal n yiwet ger ɛecra. Ma yella afran ilha, d nettat ay d tin ilhan.
fg.itineraries.6: 09:00Tiqehwa ɣef Đồng Khởi. Metiseko (8:30) yeldi izirig n luks amezwaru; ddu s ~600 m n wammas ɛeddin ɣef taḥanut tameqqrant n SIXDO d GIA Studios (tḥanutin n Taɣiwant 1).
fg.itineraries.7: 10:00Rue Miche L'Édition, Union Square B3 — 4,728 m², 120+ n mmarq Fitnamiyen ddaw yiwen usqef. D amkan yesɛan azal ameqqran deg temdint; efk-as tesɛa u ttlatin n tedqiqin.
fg.itineraries.8: 12:00Aḥmu n wammas n wass. Imekli, dɣa Vincom Đồng Khởi ɣef Lê Thánh Tôn — Daphale d CAOSTU ɣef B1, Stress Mama ɣef B2, akk s usemmiḍ.
fg.itineraries.9: 14:3042 Tôn Thất Thiệp: kkuz n tḥanutin deg yiwet n texxamt, war tikli (Dawna Vintage, 1998 Before The Dawn, Depass, Daspace) — akked yiwet n tewwurt n Bad Habits i llebsa n yergazen. Dɣa Lý Tự Trọng: The New Playground ɣef №26, Thuy Design House ɣef №44B, Wephobia ɣef №98.
fg.itineraries.10: 17:00Grab-muṭu ɣer izirig n Trần Quang Diệu, Taɣiwant 3 — 10–15 n tedqiqin, 15–30k₫ ar ugur n 2026. Ṛbeɛṭac n tḥanutin deg 800 m n yiwet n zzenqa (tḥanutin n Taɣiwant 3): Kathy Atelier d ammas, Laneci teṭṭef tawwurt alamma d 22:00.
fg.itineraries.11: 20:30Imensi qrib n izirig; iwaliyen ineggura ar uɣlaq.
fg.itineraries.12: Tuɣaleḍ-d s tɣawla? Kkes Lý Tự Trọng, mačči izirig — asrag n izirig aneggaru d nfas wis sin n wass. Ayen i d-yeɣlin ad yeṭṭef, s wudem izedɣen, tiwenat i d-iteddun.
fg.itineraries.13: 2 wussanTernu-d Taɣiwant 3 s ummid, akked tameddit taggurt n Phú Nhuận＋
fg.itineraries.14: Nɣel abrid
fg.itineraries.15: I wi ilaq: anebdad n ssibut i ibɣan snat n tɣiwanin s waṭas n tḥanutin s wudem ilhan. Ayen i t-yeɣummen s tidet: ~20–22 n tḥanutin — azal n xemsa ger ṛebɛa n tḥanutin n ukcum n temdint, d snat n iberdan yifen akk.
fg.itineraries.17: Asɣenu n yiwen wass, war abeddel. Yal tiwenat teɣzif dagi tebdu s yiwen ammas — asenfel awezlan d azwir n win izeɣzifen, mačči d abrid nniḍen.
fg.itineraries.19: 09:30Võ Văn Tần, Taɣiwant 3 — Cocosin teldi ɣer 9:00; sebɛa n tḥanutin ɣef yiwen ukilumitr yettwaddun s iḍaren: Mooris, Résel Studio, LAVIEM, So Dópe Club, Đỗ Long ɣer tagara n Bàn Cờ (tibdart n Taɣiwant 3). Llebsa n yergazen: HADES teṭṭef tawwurt deg D3 ɣef 152 Trần Quang Diệu (llebsa n yergazen deg tebdart).
fg.itineraries.20: 11:30SEESON ɣef Điện Biên Phủ — taḥanut tameqqrant n tbinaḍ s tesnulfa n tiṭṭawin d teqhwa. Abeddi n uḥmu i yeqqimen d aseɣ.
fg.itineraries.21: 14:30Nguyễn Đình Chiểu s trekbi d tikli: taḥanut tameqqrant n Vascara, Sassy Sis (teɣleq 20:30), Daniv Dear s ukwez n ttesqifat-ines.
fg.itineraries.22: 17:30Phú Nhuận i tmeddit (tibdart n Phú Nhuận): ammas n 11 Garmentory — ugar n ṛebɛa n mmarq d teqhwa ddaw yiwen usqef, alamma d 21:30 — dɣa sin n Trần Huy Liệu, Tiela d By Vee, akk ldint alamma d 22:00. Agraw ifazen n temdint i tmeddit, d win yesɛan azal ameqqran.
fg.itineraries.23: 3–4 wussanTernu-d Thảo Điền, Tân Định, ssuqat — d amahil n uxeyyaṭ＋
fg.itineraries.24: Nɣel abrid
fg.itineraries.25: I wi ilaq: tiwenat n taggara n ssimana i ibɣan tugna meṛṛa n temdint. Ayen i t-yeɣummen s tidet: ~30–38 n tḥanutin — třilt n tḥanutin n ukcum, akked kukṛad n igrawen imeqqranen.
fg.itineraries.26: Amahil n uxeyyaṭ, uqbel meṛṛa: ma yella llebsa ittwaxedmen s ufus tesɛa azal ɣur-k, awi tacekkart-ik tḥemmleḍ ɣer Dung Tailor (221 Lê Thánh Tôn, 9:00–19:00) deg wass amezwaru — taḥanut n unɣal amagnu tezmer ad tekfu deg ddaw n krad n wussan, ihi ad tili theggi uqbel ad tazleḍ (ixeyyaṭen deg tebdart).
fg.itineraries.30: 09:40Izirig 1 n Metṛo, Bến Thành → Thảo Điền — 10–12 n tedqiqin, 7–20k₫, war aɣellel n uzal, war kask deg uqerru. Imukan uɛlayen; cwiṭ imitren ineggura ḥman.
fg.itineraries.31: 10:00Fancì Club ɣer uldi (taḥanut n Y2K yettwalsen sɣur Bella Hadid d BLACKPINK), dɣa Nosbyn Studio (teɣleq 20:00 — ẓer-itt deg tafat n wass), Stress Mama, d taḥanut tameqqrant n Olaben s tesqifat-ines n Reformer (tibdart n uzal aɛlayan n Thảo Điền). Tiwenat timecṭaḥ n Grab ger izenqan — Thảo Điền tettemsagar, ur tettdawi ara s tikli.
fg.itineraries.32: 15:30Uɣal ɣer Tân Định ɣef tagara nniḍen n asif: taxxamt 214 Hai Bà Trưng — kṛad n mmarq, yiwet n tansa (Huelley Rose, Huelley, Stress Mama) — dɣa Moodswings ɣef Đặng Dung d Floralpunk ɣef Thạch Thị Thanh.
fg.itineraries.34: 08:30Taggara n ssimana? The Box Market ɣef 125 Hai Bà Trưng teldi ɣer 8:00 — d taggara n ssimana tazwart n llebsa deg temdint — akked Hello Weekend Market yettidir ugar n taggarat n ssimana, s wamagnu deg Hoa Lư Stadium; amkan yettbeddal, senned Instagram-ines deg tsimana-nni (ssuqat deg tebdart).
fg.itineraries.35: 14:00Nguyễn Trãi s trekbi d tikli — LSOUL, Libé, taḥanut tameqqrant n OLV, Levents; llebsa n yergazen ternu taḥanut tameqqrant n ICONDENIM ɣef №261 (llebsa n yergazen, azal ammas).
fg.itineraries.36: 17:00Awi anɣal-ik, dɣa uɣal ɣer izirig ilaqen tuɣri wis sin. Ad yili Trần Quang Diệu.
fg.itineraries.37: 7 wussanAritm n ssimana: mkul agraw ammas, snat n twaraq n unɣal s ufus, yiwen wass n usmuttag s tidet＋
fg.itineraries.38: Nɣel abrid
fg.itineraries.39: I wi ilaq: ssimana s tuzzuft — tiwenat n tebna n llebsa mačči d taɛemmirt kan. Ayen i t-yeɣummen s tidet: ~55–65 n tḥanutin, ugar n tazgent n tḥanutin n ukcum n temdint, s snat n twaraq n unɣal s ufus i yekfan uqbel tazuli.
fg.itineraries.40: Uqbel ad tazleḍ: tḥanutin n usmuttag — Résel Bridal, Caleelilou, Hacchic d wid yemcaben-asen — ttusmuttagent s izen n Instagram, sɛant tallunt n ssimana; ihi azen-d izen uqbel tazuli, mačči deffir-s (luks & llebsa n leqdic). Áo dài s tunɣal s ufus s ummid deg KINZU tetteṭṭef 2–3 n tsimanin — deg tiwenat n sebɛa wussan, sers-itt-id kan ma ara tt-tazneḍ neɣ ad tuɣaleḍ.
fg.itineraries.41: Ass 1Ammas n D1: izirig n Đồng Khởi, Rue Miche L'Édition, Vincom, 42 Tôn Thất Thiệp, Lý Tự Trọng. Sers acekkar ɣer Dung Tailor tafrara.
fg.itineraries.42: Ass 2Taɣiwant 3 snat n twaliwin — izirig n Trần Quang Diệu, dɣa Võ Văn Tần. Eǧǧ tuzzert-ik ɣer Duan Tailor (465A Điện Biên Phủ) ma tebɣiḍ acbel: izirig-ines aẓrar yettazzal 24–48 n twenatin.
fg.itineraries.43: Ass 3Azgen wass n Thảo Điền s metṛo; tameddit tilelli s wudem asfulel. Aẓay s wudem yebɣan — ttuɣal n twaɣit d tidet.
fg.itineraries.44: Ass 4Ismuttagen, s tsusmi n wass n uxeddim: imsawalen n leqdic, tizirig n Lê Thánh Tôn n unɣal s ufus (Dung Tailor, ManGii custom shoes — ~800k–3M₫ mkul aqerrab), taḥanut n Rue Miche ɣef Đa Kao. Awi amahil aẓrar n Duan.
fg.itineraries.45: Ass 5Ass n usmuttag, s tidet. Yiwen ssuq ma tegzi taggara n ssimana; ma ulac, ulac ayen ara yeddun war ass ur nelli n usɣenu.
fg.itineraries.46: Ass 6Ass n uzal n Phú Nhuận — 11 Garmentory, sin n Trần Huy Liệu, L'Espoir — dɣa tuɣalin wis sin ɣer tḥanutin n D1/D3 i tferneḍ. Tuɣalin d wiyeẓẓi mi ara yettwassen ugraw; d nettat ay d win ittwaxedmen i ufran.
fg.itineraries.47: Ass 7Izirig n Bến Thành d Nguyễn Trãi, tikessarin tineggura d asewzel, akked twenat n usdukel: GrabExpress akk ɣer usiwan, neɣ efk-aɣ tabdart — tawurit tazen ddunit meṛṛa.
fg.itineraries.48: 14 wussanTimana tamezwarut tettili, timana tis snat teɣzif — akked tɣiwanin ibeṛṛaniyin i yesɛan azal n tiwenat＋
fg.itineraries.49: Nɣel abrid
fg.itineraries.50: I wi ilaq: asemzeggi n ssimana snat — tallunt i tɣiwanin ibeṛṛaniyin d twaraq n usttag ilhan. Ayen i t-yeɣummen s tidet: ~85 n tḥanutin, tlata n ṛebɛa n tḥanutin n ukcum n temdint, ula d yal amahil n yiwet n taḥanut i yuklalen iman-is.
fg.itineraries.51: Ssimana tamezwarut d asɣenu n sebɛa wussan s ṭṭawil ugar — igrawen-nni, aẓay ugar. Sers-d amahil aɣezfan tikkelt-nni: áo dài s unɣal s ufus n KINZU (3.7–20M₫, 2–3 n tsimanin) yekfa asɣenu-ines s tidet kan ma yebda deg wass amezwaru neɣ wis sin.
fg.itineraries.52: Ssimana tis snat ternu-d tɣiwanin i xesren tiwenat tiwezlanin, yiwet n tiwenat mkul yiwet, teɣummen s ummid:
fg.itineraries.53: Q10Sin n Sư Vạn Hạnh — Levents ɣef №842 d taḥanut n Ananas ɣef №427, yiwet n zzenqa, yiwet n tiwenat.
fg.itineraries.54: Tân PhúFeng ɣef 11B Thoại Ngọc Hầu — afran gar ṛebɛa yifen, d amahil n yiwet n taḥanut kan i nettmuttag war asteqsi (tibdart n Tân Phú).
fg.itineraries.55: Q5Thao Bibi d The Country Boutiques, akked Chợ Lớn s timmad-ines (tibdart n Taɣiwant 5).
fg.itineraries.56: D7LI LAM ɣef Crescent Mall; sebded-t ɣer lḥed amezwaru neɣ wis krad n ssimana dɣa rnu Saigon Flea Market.
fg.itineraries.57: Bình ThạnhFitme ɣef Xô Viết Nghệ Tĩnh; leqdic n lḥarir n Hà Linh Thu s usmuttag (tibdart n Bình Thạnh).
fg.itineraries.58: Sin wussan n war-aseɣ s ummid deg ssimana tis snat, ttwabedren dagi akken ur asen-tettmyugareḍ ara ticki. Azgen aneggaru n ssimana d twaraq d ismuttagen — s tebna aẓay ugar wala amezwaru, acku ass wis tnac ur ilaq ara ad yemcabi ɣer wass amezwaru. Azen-d akken tettedduḍ: tiwenat n GrabExpress ɣer usiwan mkul tameddit ad yeǧǧ mkul tiwenat teḍfeṛ s cwiṭ n uɛebbi.
fg.itineraries.59: 30 wassAqama: tuɣri tamezwarut tettili, tuɣri tis snat teɣzif, yal amahil yekfa＋
fg.itineraries.60: Nɣel abrid
fg.itineraries.61: I wi ilaq: ayyur deg temdint — tiwenat ideg unɣal s ufus ur yerri ara d amenzu maca d ayen yesɛan azal ameqqran. Ayen i t-yeɣummen s tidet: akk ~110 n tḥanutin n ukcum ma tebɣiḍ, rnu tazgent n usmuttag i wid n tiwenat tiwezlanin ur nettnal ara — maca ɣer ssimana tis krad, tuɣri tis snat tesɛa azal ugar n uḍris.
fg.itineraries.62: Ssimana 1Ldi yal amahil. Tuɣri tazwart n wammas (D1 snat n twaliwin, D3 snat n twaliwin, Phú Nhuận tameddit) mi ara ibdu umahil aɣezfan: áo dài n KINZU (2–3 n tsimanin), imsawalen n leqdic s izen d asiwel (Résel Bridal, Linh Nga, Le Thanh Hoa), iqerraben n ManGii — akked llebsa taɣezfant s ummid, i deg SIR Tailor yefka azal n 21–30 wass s sin n twaraq n usenqed drus-nsent. Rray-agi kan i yezgan i wagi (ixeyyaṭen deg tebdart).
fg.itineraries.63: Ssimana 2Tɣiwanin ibeṛṛaniyin — Thảo Điền d Thủ Đức uzzigen, Q10, Q5, Tân Phú, Bình Thạnh, D7 s lḥed n ssuq-ines — yiwen ugraw mkul ass, ṛebɛa ar xemsa wussan n useɣ deg ssimana, weradeg ugar.
fg.itineraries.64: Ssimana 3Tuɣri tis snat. Isenqad, tuɣalin ɣer tḥanutin yettwafernen, ismuttagen n wussan n uxeddim, akked ssuqat i uzuzer mačči i tehwaǧa. Ayen mazal-it ur yettwaliɣ ara yesra tamawt.
fg.itineraries.65: Ssimana 4Isenqad ineggura akked twenat n usdukel — áo dài yewweḍ, llebsa taɣezfant tekfa asenqed-ines aneggaru — tikkelt tanggarut n sin igrawen imeqqranen, dɣa asdukel: yiwet n twenat i tazwara, mačči ɛecrin. Nettxeddem-t s uzref, ddunit meṛṛa — bdu s usiḍen.
fg.itineraries.66: Tazgalt n useggas: ma yella ayyur-inek yenna ɣer Tết, aseggas amaynut aqmaṛi (taggara n Yennayer–Fuṛar), ẓer belli tḥanutin ilelliyen ad ffɣent seg umahil i ssimana neɣ ugar — yal taḥanut tessawal ussan-ines n uɣlaq ɣef Instagram. Sɣenu abeddel; ur t-nnaɣ ara. Yerna deg yal ayyur, eǧǧ ussan n usmuttag n ssimana. Aqama yettseɣen mkul ass ur yettwali ara sya ɣer wass wis ɛecra.
fg.rhythms.3: Taḥanut tamagnut n Saygun teldi ger 9:30 d 10:00, teɣleq ger 21:00 d 21:30, s sebɛa wussan deg ssimana — asrag i tt-yettmennan ugar n temdinin. Sɣenu deg 10:30–20:00 dɣa qrib yal taḥanut s isragen ittwabderen teldi. Tifrarin n tḥanutin d ussan iɣawlanen; efk-asent i ssuqat, ismuttagen, neɣ tiwenat ɣer Thảo Điền. Isnulfa yuklalen tabna-inek fell-asen:
fg.rhythms.4: Tḥanutin s isragen ur nemgarad ara i wanida tesɣenuḍ
fg.rhythms.10: Tawwurt tazwarut n izirig n luks — bdu Đồng Khởi dagi.
fg.rhythms.13: Teldi taxxamt n 214 Hai Bà Trưng zik.
fg.rhythms.16: Teɣleq uqbel imensi — sers icekkaren tafrara.
fg.rhythms.19: Sin n Phú Nhuận n tmeddit taggurt, ger snat n tewwura.
fg.rhythms.22: Tibinaḍ, tesnulfa n tiṭṭawin d teqhwa — abeddi asfulel n wammas n wass.
fg.rhythms.25: Tis krad n Phú Nhuận i yeɣlaqen ɣer 22:00.
fg.rhythms.28: Aɣlaq zik n Thảo Điền — ṛuḥ deg tafat n wass.
fg.rhythms.31: Anagraw-nni s timmad, ɣef Nguyễn Huệ.
fg.rhythms.37: Win yettalin s taɣawla — werǧin d amezwaru deg webrid n tefrara.
fg.rhythms.40: Ayen n wammas n wass kan, yiwen usqef sennig Kathy Atelier.
fg.rhythms.43: Aɣlaq aneggaru ɣef izirig n Trần Quang Diệu — kfu dinna.
fg.rhythms.46: Tiwwura n ssuq tizwarin d tineggura deg D1.
fg.rhythms.48: Taggara n ssimana d tin n ssuqat: Hello Weekend — ssuq n llebsa n ilmeẓyen ameqqran deg temdint — yettidir ugar n taggarat n ssimana, s wamagnu deg Hoa Lư Stadium, maca amkan yettbeddal; senned Instagram-ines deg tsimana-nni. Saigon Flea yettili lḥed amezwaru d wis krad deg D7, ma d Urban Flea yettuɣal ɣer Saigon Outcast deg Thảo Điền s tawala-ines. Ussan n uxeddim d wid ideg ismuttagen ttilin s tsusmi ugar. Yerna yiwen wul aẓidan deg akk isefka-nneɣ, ula d wid-nneɣ: ulac talɣut yettwattkalen ɣef wussan n usmuttag n tḥanutin i yettwasegren s Instagram — tḥanutin ɣlaqent war lexbar, daymi izen n wass uqbel mačči d anazur maca d asegzawal.
fg.rhythms.50: Anẓar yezga ɣef tiwaci seg Mayyu ar Wamber, aɛlay-is Ɣuct–Tuber; iyyuren iqquren, Wamber–Yennayer, ttawin-d agu adiri n useggas deg wemḍiq-ines. Ulac lawan ilhan s ummid — llan kan icekkiwen yemgarraden. Tisɣatin i yuklalen tamawt: tazrirt tameqqrant n useɣ n wammas n useggas n 7.7 (Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop — aṭas n mmarq n webrid seɣlen deg Shopee Mall mačči deg tḥanutin), akked Red Sale n Vincom deg tḥanutin-ines meṛṛa, aseggas-agi alamma d 70% alamma d 20 Yulyuz. Yerna ma yella ussan-ik ɛeddan ɣef Tết, ẓer belli tḥanutin ilelliyen ɣlaqent i ssimana neɣ ugar, yal yiwet s wass-ines.
fg.rhythms.52: S wudem asefdid, acku asirem mačči d asɣenu: taḥanut tetteṭṭef 20–35 n tesdatin mi ara tettwaliḍ s tidet. Abeddel n ugraw yesra 20–30 n tesdatin seg tewwurt ɣer tewwurt ula ma tiwenat s timmad-ines d ɛecra: asebded, arja, ikaskiten, asenselɣ. Ammas n wass yefka snat ar krad n twenatin i uḥmu d imekli. Awi tallunt n 10:00–21:30, kkes akk-a, feṛq ɣef wakud n mkul taḥanut, ad d-yeffeɣ tmanya ar ɛecra n tḥanutin — ass yeččuṛen, ilhan. Isɣnuten i d-ineḥḥun ɛecrin ttmeslayen ɣef uzzel zdat n tiwwura, mačči ɣef useɣ.
fg.rhythms.53: Tazgalt i yeddan seg deffir n wayen akk-a: tḥanutin n Saygun ttbeddilent amkan s waṭas, isragen-nsent bedlent war lexbar, yerna azal n tazgent n tḥanutin n ukcum n temdint ur d-fkant ara isragen s wudem: sɣenu s tanaḍt n 10:00–21:00, azen izen i taḥanut ass uqbel, mkul tikkelt. Ismawen n tɣiwanin bedlen deg wammas n 2025 s usnifel aɣlanant; Grab d Google Maps mazal-ten ssnen ismawen iqburen n tɣiwanin, akked tibdart-nneɣ. Azal dagi d imḍanen, seg ugur n 2026, ad bedlen.
fg.cta.h: Ur tebɣiḍ ara ad t-tedduḍ s yiman-ik?
fg.cta.p: Wagi d amnir ilelli. Mi ara tebɣuḍ ad ternuḍ tḥanutin ittwafernen fell-ak, ismuttagen ittwasebden, isenqad s wakud yettwaḥsaben, akked wayen akk yettwaznen ɣer wexxam deg yiwet n tuffirt — d amahil n tewurit-nneɣ.
fg.foot.6: Ɣer asebter-a yiwet n tikkelt uqbel tiwenat, dɣa idir seg tebdart mi ara telliḍ dagi — isɣnuten ɛeddin s wudem uɣlin ɣer ifiltṛen-ines. Tansiwin d wazal d imḍanen n ugur n 2026 seg iberdan n mmarq, tira n 2025–26, d tikli-nneɣ s timmad; tḥanutin ttbeddilent amkan s waṭas — azen izen i taḥanut ass uqbel ad tṛuḥeḍ. Ismawen n tɣiwanin bedlen deg wammas n 2025; Grab & Google Maps mazal-ten ssnen ismawen iqburen.
